stance_rationale: Reject as an optimizer handoff: the package audits sleeve weights instead of security weights, shows max observed sleeve weight 0.50 against the 0.20 hard bound, exceeds the <=10 method-shopping cap, and leaves a CVaR breach without infeasibility handling. The 256-row CSV reduces pure single-date risk, but it is not the required ticker-long walk-forward schedule and key PIT artifacts are missing.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: Sleeve-level selected turnover is zero, but sleeve-internal monthly 1715 and TSMOM turnover is excluded; full-portfolio cost and net_IR are therefore not audited.

hard_constraint_violations: RF-O6: observed sleeve max_w=0.50 exceeds 0.20 hard bound if the CSV is treated as the deployable weight file
RF-O5: expanded security-level max_names cannot be verified from the sleeve-wide CSV
RF-O8: monthly CVaR_95 0.0458 risk truth and 0.0551 optimizer basis exceed the 0.025 cap
RF-O9: required as_of_date x ticker x weight schedule and alpha_scores.parquet are absent

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: Not reported; optimizer package does not provide replacement vs integration or blended SR/MDD/IR.

critical_concerns.description: weights.csv is sleeve-wide, not as_of_date x ticker x weight, and the selected sleeve weights include w_str1715=0.50 and w_tsmom=0.25. This cannot certify the mandated per-name 0.20 bound and directly fails if the CSV is the deployable weight file.

max_names and liquidity are not auditable at security level: the package counts four sleeves while the expanded book may include 20 KR stocks plus ETFs, bond ETF, and cash. The optimizer also uses 5e7 KRW liquidity language against the base 2e8 KRW hard constraint.

Method shopping used 16 total candidates despite the <=10 cap. The selected baseline is justified partly by rejecting EW4 as alpha redefinition even though EW4 has higher SR_net, lower MDD, and lower CVaR in the reported optimizer comparison.

CVaR remains above cap: risk truth monthly_cvar_95=0.0458 and optimizer basis=0.0551 exceed the 0.025 cap, while infeasibility_report is null. Rglpk unavailable is not sufficient under AX-000 when the tail-aware LP was the relevant remedy.

Walk-forward handoff is incomplete: qepm/mailbox weights.csv is absent, qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260511_002 alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet are absent, and the existing CSV has one unique selected weight vector rather than security-level rolling alpha/universe/Sigma recomputation evidence.

Cost audit is understated because estimated_cost=0 only covers sleeve-level static weights and explicitly excludes internal 1715 monthly rebalance and TSMOM rotation turnover. This blocks net_IR and RF-O2 cost asymmetry verification.

The optimizer says it uses a regularized 4-sleeve covariance for solvers, but covariance_4sleeve_regularized.parquet has condition number about 374642.9, far above the <=100 post-shrink target; the legacy 4-sleeve covariance is singular.

Iter-specific alignment is weak: tsmom has AX-001 borderline crisis_alpha and CRISIS str1715-tsmom coupling is positive, yet the retained static schedule keeps tsmom at 25% and applies no confidence-aware shrinkage or crisis boundary reduction.

Sequential Admission and beta drift are not handled: beta_port is inherited as about 0.465 versus the checklist target band or mandate clarification, and replacement/integration against PG2/MEGA_05 is not reported.

supporting_arguments: The existing stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_002/weights.csv has 256 as_of_dates, row sums equal 1.0, and nonnegative sleeve weights.
The primary 3-sleeve covariance.parquet is PSD with condition number about 22.856, passing the <=100 condition check before cash inclusion.
Hill alpha is 2.503, so RF-O12 heavy-tail MVO override is not triggered by the stated threshold.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the hard constraints apply to expanded underlying securities or whether this WT is allowed to certify only sleeve aggregates.
Whether the CVaR cap waiver is a formal Governor/Q-Lead artifact or an optimizer-side assertion.
Whether EW4 is a valid optimizer candidate or was improperly rejected as alpha redefinition.
Whether internal sleeve turnover and costs are already charged upstream and can be reconciled into full portfolio net_IR.
Whether alpha_scores.parquet exists elsewhere; it is missing from the required WT-D20260511_002 paths.
weakest_assumption: That a static sleeve-level 50/20/25/5 schedule can be treated as a compliant per-name, PIT walk-forward optimizer output without publishing expanded security weights, internal costs, alpha_scores, or CVaR infeasibility handling.
rebuttal_required: Publish ticker-long weights.csv with as_of_date, ticker, weight, method_selected and prove max_names<=20 and max_w<=0.20 per date.
Provide alpha_scores.parquet or an equivalent PIT time-series alpha artifact for every rebalance date.
Issue an infeasibility_report or formal waiver for CVaR_95 above 2.5%, including why CVaR LP was not run despite Rglpk unavailability.
Redo method-shopping within the <=10 candidate cap or document the governance exception.
Reconcile full portfolio turnover and costs, including 1715 and TSMOM sleeve-internal trading.
Report replacement and integration scenarios versus the active PG2/MEGA_05 book with blended SR, MDD, IR, and TDC basis.
